text:
lia_dev: FYI I'm seeing a ~2.5s regression in initial chart render on /dash after last night's frontend deploy. LCP spike and noticeable chart shimmer for cold cache users. @cheng can you take a look?
infra-bot: deploy finished: frontend@2026.03.15-rc.4 — rollout complete 03:12 UTC :white_check_mark:
cheng: I pulled a few traces — aggregate median LCP on /dash jumped from 1.1s to 3.6s between 03:00-04:00 UTC. Devtools trace shows a long style recalculation right after the chart JS eval.
sam_h: my theory: we switched chart CSS to dynamic import to reduce bundle size: 
```js
// Chart component
useEffect(() => {
  import('./chart-styles.css');
}, []);
```
That avoids shipping CSS in the main chunk but delays style application until after JS executes.
nina_q: repro steps: clear site data, load /dash, open devtools performance — you see FOUC then charts repaint. Console isn't throwing errors but repaint times match the lag. I can attach a trace if helpful.
lia_dev: yep that's consistent with telemetry. Token-level traces show a big spike in style recalculation on first paint. We saw a 40% increase in total-blocking-time for new users.
ux-maya: can we avoid UX hit while keeping bundle size wins? Maybe preload or inline critical rules for the chart container.
cheng: quick options: 1) revert the dynamic import, 2) add `<link rel=preload as=style href=/static/chart-styles.css>` during SSR for /dash, 3) inline minimal critical CSS for the top-level chart shell and lazy-load the rest.
sam_h: option 3 is lowest-risk and keeps bundle smaller. Quick patch: inline 8-10 rules that unblock layout (width/height, canvas/bg, font smoothing), then lazy-load the rest.
nina_q: I can validate with a canary if we ship a minor change. Will test on 5% rollout.
cheng: I'll open a PR with the inline-critical and a preload fallback. Patch diff preview: 
```diff
+<style id="chart-critical">.chart{min-height:240px;min-width:300px;contain:layout;}</style>
+<link rel="preload" as="style" href="/static/chart-styles.css" onload="this.rel='stylesheet'">
```
lia_dev: thanks. Also add a telemetry flag so we can compare canary vs baseline (LCP, TBT, first-paint). Tag the rollout with `chart-css-critical-v1` in the console.
cheng: will do. Planning: PR in 30m, canary 10% for 1 hour, then 100% if metrics look good.
ux-maya: please coordinate with product for any UX notes, but this sounds safe.
sam_h: re: bundle size — we should add a comment in the chart package about critical rules and revisit a build-time critical CSS extractor later.
lia_dev: thanks all. nina — please attach the trace to the PR for post-mortem. I'll monitor alerts. :eyes: 
nina_q: on it, attaching trace + lighthouse snapshot once PR is up.
infra-bot: rollout scheduled: frontend@chart-css-critical-v1 — canary 10% in 15m.
lia_dev: great — let's keep the thread for rollout notes. React with :thumbsup: when you've seen this.
